reviews.review_description: Great game I’m the tester btw

This is pure, chaotic fun—a cartoonish UFO abduction simulator where you snatch everything from pets to cars to unsuspecting humans, all while dodging helicopters like a cosmic prankster. The smooth flying, sharp controls, and rewarding progression (unlocking new levels and abilities) make it addictively playful, and the bright, cartoony art style fits the whimsical tone perfectly.

Early access means more chaos is coming, and if this game is an indication, it’s going to be hilariously chaotic. Time to beam up some trouble! 🚁👽

Fun little game to wile away some time.

Controls are responsive and it’s very cute.

Only just discovered this for free and it well worth your time.
